llm.summary: GIII produced a clean liftoff and positive excess return attributed to company-specific alpha. Consumer Discretionary rotation and catalyst effects remain untested.
llm.root_cause: GIII produced a clean liftoff and positive excess return attributed to company-specific alpha. Consumer Discretionary rotation and catalyst effects remain untested.
llm.lesson: The watch and company-alpha books surfaced GIII, while the rotation, catalyst, and timing engines cannot be adjudicated.
llm.engines_credit: The company-alpha book is the provisional role model; no supplied evidence identifies a laggard book or organ.

causal_chain.mechanism: An unspecified company-specific advantage drove relative outperformance.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Absent company alpha, sector rotation or event-driven re-rating would need to account for the result.

causal_chain.mechanism: The clean watch process retained exposure to the favorable move.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Delayed confirmation might have reduced capture, although the actual path is unavailable.

alternate_explanations: Consumer Discretionary rotation may have contributed.
A company catalyst may have caused an external re-rating.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Company-alpha confirmation within the watch lane
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare entry-date sector-relative momentum and accumulation features across matured watch picks.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Stronger company-relative confirmation should be associated with clean liftoffs.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: The features fail to distinguish liftoffs from stopped or dead-money watch outcomes.
